name: COBOL and IBM Mainframe Development
certifications: IBM Z Xplore badges (Concepts, Fundamentals and Advanced)
IBM Certified Application Developer - Enterprise COBOL
IBM Certified Database Associate - Db2 for z/OS
tools: IBM z/OS (IBM Z Xplore or Z Development and Test Environment)
VS Code with Zowe Explorer and IBM Z Open Editor

beginner.summary: For graduates and developers new to the mainframe. Covers z/OS concepts, TSO/ISPF, data sets, JCL, utilities and SORT, COBOL program structure, data definitions, arithmetic, control flow, sequential files, tables, string handling, subprograms, compiling and linking, abends, report programs, VSAM, embedded Db2 SQL and CICS concepts.
outcomes: Work with z/OS through TSO/ISPF and Zowe
Write and run JCL with common utilities
Write COBOL batch programs that process files, tables and Db2 data
Diagnose common abends and fix them

days.topic: Mainframe Overview and z/OS Environment Setup
subtopics: Where mainframes are used: banks, insurance, government and airlines
IBM Z hardware and z/OS in simple terms
Address spaces and subsystems: JES, TSO, CICS and Db2
Getting a practice account on IBM Z Xplore
VS Code with Zowe Explorer and IBM Z Open Editor
The course data sets and naming rules
days.lab_task: Get a practice z/OS account, log on with a 3270 emulator and with Zowe Explorer, list your data sets with both, submit the sample job and view its output.
days.deliverable: Connection notes, screenshots and job output
checks: List data sets in Zowe Explorer
Difference stated with an example of each

days.topic: TSO and ISPF Navigation and Editing
subtopics: ISPF editor primary commands: FIND, CHANGE and SORT
days.lab_task: Edit a COBOL member with line and primary commands, change text across a member, find data sets with option 3.4 and read job output and messages in SDSF.
days.deliverable: Edited member and a command cheat sheet
checks: Copy, move and delete lines with line commands
Change a word throughout the member

days.topic: Data Sets: Sequential, Partitioned and Their Attributes
subtopics: Record formats: F, FB, V and VB
Logical record length and block size
Space allocation in tracks and cylinders
Allocating data sets with ISPF and Zowe
days.lab_task: Allocate a sequential data set, a PDS and a PDSE with suitable attributes, copy members between them, fill a data set until it runs out of space and fix the allocation.
days.deliverable: Data set attributes and notes
checks: RECFM, LRECL and BLKSIZE as planned
Space abend explained and allocation fixed
Data set created from the command line

days.topic: Job Control Language: Jobs, Steps and DD Statements
subtopics: IF, THEN and ELSE in JCL
days.lab_task: Write a three-step job that creates a data set, copies data into it and prints it, then make step three run only when step two ends with return code 0.
days.deliverable: JCL and job output
checks: All steps end with return code 0
Step three skipped by the IF test
Re-run with DISP=NEW on an existing data set

days.lab_task: Sort a customer file by region and balance, filter out closed accounts, reformat records, total balances by region with SUM and merge two sorted files.
days.deliverable: JCL for each task and output data sets
checks: Only open accounts in the right order
One record per region with correct totals

days.topic: COBOL Program Structure and First Programs
subtopics: Areas A and B and column rules
days.lab_task: Write a program that reads a name from SYSIN, displays a greeting and today's date, compile and run it with a supplied procedure and fix two compile errors.
days.deliverable: Program source, compile listing and output
checks: Return code 0 or 4 with warnings explained
Errors removed with the reason noted

days.topic: Data Division: PICTURE Clauses and Data Items
subtopics: PICTURE clauses for numbers and text
How data is stored in memory
days.lab_task: Define a customer record with group items, signed packed decimal balances, condition names for account status and a REDEFINES for a date, then display each field.
days.deliverable: Program source and output

days.topic: Moving Data and Arithmetic in COBOL
subtopics: MOVE rules for text and numbers
days.lab_task: Calculate interest and fees for accounts with COMPUTE and ROUNDED, catch overflow with ON SIZE ERROR and show what happens when a value is moved to a field that is too small.
days.deliverable: Program source, output and notes
checks: Results match a spreadsheet to the cent

days.topic: Control Flow: IF, EVALUATE and PERFORM
days.lab_task: Write a program that classifies transactions with EVALUATE, loops through a set of test values with PERFORM VARYING and is structured into clear paragraphs with no GO TO.
days.deliverable: Program source and output
checks: One task per paragraph and no GO TO
Loop ends at the right count

subtopics: Reading and writing in a loop
Linking file names to DD statements
days.lab_task: Read a transaction file, write valid records to one file and invalid ones to another with a reason, check FILE STATUS on every operation and print record counts.
days.deliverable: Program, JCL and output files
checks: Valid and invalid counts add up to the input count

days.lab_task: Load a product price table from a file, look up prices for each order with SEARCH ALL, total sales by product and month in a two-dimensional table and print the summary.
days.deliverable: Program source and summary output
checks: Totals match a DFSORT SUM result

days.lab_task: Parse comma-separated customer records with UNSTRING, clean names with INSPECT and functions, build formatted address lines with STRING and validate email formats.
days.deliverable: Program source and output
checks: Parse a record with empty fields
Extra spaces removed and case fixed

days.lab_task: Move date validation into a subprogram called by two main programs, share the record layout through a copybook and compare static and dynamic calls.
days.deliverable: Programs, copybook and output
checks: Both programs use the new layout

subtopics: The compile, bind and go process
days.lab_task: Compile and bind a program with your own JCL rather than a procedure, change compiler options and read the cross-reference listing to find where a field is changed.
days.deliverable: Compile and bind JCL and listings
checks: Lines that change the field listed
Change an option such as SSRANGE

days.lab_task: Run four programs that abend with S0C7, S0C4, S806 and S322, find each cause from the messages and dump, fix them and add checks that stop the S0C7 happening again.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes and fixed programs
checks: Bad numeric data rejected instead of abending

subtopics: Control breaks on one and two levels
days.lab_task: Write a sales report with page headings, two levels of control breaks for region and branch, edited amounts and grand totals that balance with the input.
days.deliverable: Program and printed report

subtopics: VSAM data set types: KSDS, ESDS and RRDS
days.lab_task: Define and load a customer KSDS, write a program that reads by key, browses from a starting key and updates and deletes records, handling duplicate and not-found status codes.
days.deliverable: IDCAMS JCL, program and output

days.topic: Embedded SQL with Db2 for z/OS
subtopics: Testing SQL in SPUFI or Zowe
days.lab_task: Write a program that reads account updates from a file and applies them to a Db2 table, handling not-found and null values, and check the results with SPUFI.
days.deliverable: Program, JCL and SPUFI output

subtopics: Where CICS fits with Db2 and VSAM
days.lab_task: Run and trace a sample inquiry transaction, map each screen to the program and file calls behind it and explain how pseudo-conversational design frees resources between screens.
days.deliverable: Transaction flow diagram and explanation
checks: Customer data shown on the screen

days.lab_task: Build a nightly billing batch: sort transactions, validate them against a VSAM customer file, calculate charges, update Db2 balances, print a balanced report and chain the steps in one job with restart notes.
days.deliverable: Programs, JCL, test data, report and demo recording
checks: All steps succeed and report totals balance
Rejected with reasons and the job continues
Job completes from the restart point
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one batch system

intermediate.summary: For mainframe developers with some COBOL experience. Covers advanced JCL with procedures and GDGs, DFSORT and ICETOOL, VSAM with IDCAMS, Db2 cursors and binds, Db2 performance, CICS programming with BMS, CICS with Db2 and VSAM, IMS concepts, batch scheduling, COBOL performance, Enterprise COBOL 6, unit testing, debugging tools, dumps, REXX, change management, MQ, data conversion and RACF.
prerequisites: Writes COBOL batch programs with files and tables
outcomes: Build batch and CICS applications with Db2, VSAM and MQ
Test, debug and read dumps confidently
Work within change management, scheduling and security controls

days.topic: JCL Procedures, Symbolic Parameters and GDGs
days.lab_task: Turn the billing job into a procedure with symbolic parameters, write daily outputs to a GDG keeping seven generations and restart the job from a failed step without reprocessing earlier steps.
days.deliverable: Procedures, GDG definition and restart output

subtopics: ICETOOL operators: COUNT, OCCUR and SPLICE
days.lab_task: Match customers and orders with JOINKEYS, write three output files with OUTFIL, count duplicates with ICETOOL and replace a small COBOL program with a sort step.
days.deliverable: Sort control statements and outputs
checks: Same output with less CPU time

subtopics: KSDS internals: control intervals and splits
Backup and restore with REPRO and EXPORT
days.lab_task: Add an alternate index on customer email, access it from COBOL, check splits with LISTCAT after heavy inserts and reorganise the file to remove them.
days.deliverable: IDCAMS JCL, program and LISTCAT output

days.topic: Db2 for z/OS Programming: Cursors, Binds and Packages
days.lab_task: Write a batch program that processes 100,000 rows with a cursor and multi-row fetch, commits every 1,000 rows, restarts after a failure and is bound as a package.
days.deliverable: Program, DCLGEN, bind JCL and output
checks: Kill the job half-way and restart
CPU time lower with multi-row fetch

subtopics: Tools: Data Studio and IBM Db2 Administration Tool
days.lab_task: EXPLAIN five slow queries from the billing system, rewrite stage 2 predicates, ask for a missing index and show the new access paths and CPU times.
days.deliverable: EXPLAIN output before and after and change notes
checks: CPU time lower after the changes

days.lab_task: Build a customer inquiry and update transaction with a BMS map, pseudo-conversational logic, PF key handling and RESP checking, and define it with CEDA.
days.deliverable: Map, program, resource definitions and screenshots

days.topic: CICS with Db2, VSAM and Temporary Storage
days.lab_task: Add a paged customer list to the transaction using VSAM browse and temporary storage, an update that changes VSAM and Db2 in one unit of work and a rollback test.
days.deliverable: Programs and test results
checks: Update the same record from two terminals

days.topic: IMS Database and Transaction Manager Concepts
days.lab_task: Read an existing IMS batch program, draw its database hierarchy, trace its DL/I calls and change it to report one extra field.
days.deliverable: Hierarchy diagram, call trace and changed program
checks: Each GU, GN and GNP explained

days.topic: Batch Scheduling with Control-M and CA 7
days.lab_task: Define the billing jobs in a scheduler with dependencies and a calendar, simulate a failure, restart the flow and document it for operations.
days.deliverable: Job flow definition, restart log and operations document
checks: Dependent jobs held and an alert raised

subtopics: Profiling with IBM Application Performance Analyzer
days.lab_task: Profile the billing program, change numeric formats, compiler options, search method and buffering, and report CPU saved for each change.
days.deliverable: Profile reports and a savings table

days.lab_task: Produce JSON for customer records with JSON GENERATE, parse incoming JSON orders with JSON PARSE and recompile an old program, fixing behaviour differences found in testing.
days.deliverable: Programs, JSON samples and migration notes

subtopics: Why unit tests on the mainframe
IBM Test Accelerator for Z or zUnit
tools: IBM Test Accelerator for Z or zUnit
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for the charge calculation and date validation, stub the Db2 and file calls, run them from the Zowe CLI and report code coverage.
days.deliverable: Tests, results and coverage report
objectives: Run tests from the command line

subtopics: When to use debuggers or dumps
days.lab_task: Find two logic bugs in a batch program and one in a CICS transaction by stepping through code, watching fields and changing values during the run.
days.deliverable: Debug notes and fixed programs
checks: Wrong condition identified at a breakpoint

days.lab_task: Find the failing statement in three dumps by matching offsets to the listing, read working-storage values at the time of failure and write a cause report for each.
days.deliverable: Three dump analyses
checks: Failing statement found in the listing

days.lab_task: Write an edit macro that adds a standard change log to members, a REXX tool that lists jobs with non-zero return codes and a script that allocates a developer's work data sets.
days.deliverable: REXX execs and sample runs
checks: Change log added to the member
Existing data sets handled without error

days.topic: Source Control and Change Management: Endevor, ChangeMan and Git
subtopics: Moving from library tools to Git
days.lab_task: Take a change through Endevor or ChangeMan from development to test with approvals, then put the same code in Git, make a branch change and open a pull request.
days.deliverable: Package or element history and Git pull request
checks: Element at the test stage with approval
Who changed what and when shown

days.topic: IBM MQ on z/OS for Application Developers
days.lab_task: Send order messages from a batch program to a queue, process them with a triggered CICS program, handle a poison message with a backout queue and confirm delivery to a distributed client.
days.deliverable: Programs, queue definitions and test results

days.topic: Data Conversion: EBCDIC, Packed Decimal and File Transfers
subtopics: File transfers with FTP, SFTP and Connect:Direct
days.lab_task: Convert a file with packed decimal fields to CSV using DFSORT and a Python copybook parser, transfer it securely, and fix a code page error that corrupts special characters.
days.deliverable: Conversion steps, CSV output and fix notes
checks: File sent over SFTP or Connect:Direct

subtopics: Security errors and how to read them
days.lab_task: Read the RACF profiles protecting your data sets, test access with another user, request access to a production data set through the right process and diagnose an ICH408I message.
days.deliverable: Profile listings, test results and diagnosis
checks: Profiles protecting your data sets shown

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Online and Batch Banking Application
days.lab_task: Build a banking application with a CICS account inquiry and transfer transaction on Db2, a nightly batch with GDGs and restarts scheduled in a scheduler, MQ notifications to a distributed system, unit tests and a release through change management.
days.deliverable: Programs, JCL, schedule, tests, change record and demo recording
checks: Both accounts updated in one unit of work
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one application

advanced.summary: For senior mainframe developers, architects and modernisation leads. Covers modernisation strategy, APIs with z/OS Connect, mainframe DevOps, Zowe, analysing legacy code, refactoring COBOL, moving workloads to cloud, data replication, CICS and Db2 tuning, Parallel Sysplex, WLM, MIPS cost, security and encryption, AI code assistants, batch optimisation, SMF analysis, test automation, knowledge transfer and leading modernisation programmes.
prerequisites: Builds CICS, Db2 and batch COBOL applications
Works with change management and scheduling
outcomes: Plan and lead mainframe modernisation with clear business cases
Expose and integrate mainframe systems through APIs, DevOps and data replication
Tune performance and cost across CICS, Db2 and batch
Protect knowledge, security and reliability during change

subtopics: Options: retain, rehost, replatform, refactor, replace and retire
days.lab_task: Assess five applications of a case bank, choose a modernisation option for each with a business case and build a three-year incremental roadmap.
days.deliverable: Assessment, business cases and roadmap

days.topic: Exposing Mainframe Services with z/OS Connect APIs
subtopics: OpenAPI from CICS and IMS programs
Data mapping between JSON and copybooks
Calling out from COBOL to REST APIs
API security with OAuth and certificates
days.lab_task: Expose the account inquiry transaction as a REST API with OpenAPI, map JSON to the COMMAREA, secure it with OAuth through a gateway and call an external REST service from COBOL.
days.deliverable: OpenAPI spec, mappings, gateway configuration and test results
checks: External data used in the transaction

subtopics: Git as the source of truth
Pipelines with Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions
Deployment with UrbanCode Deploy or Wazi Deploy
Development and test environments with Wazi
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that builds only changed COBOL programs and their dependants with DBB, runs unit tests, deploys to a test LPAR and records lead time.
days.deliverable: Pipeline configuration, build reports and deployment log
checks: Commit to test deployment time recorded

subtopics: IBM Z Open Editor language support
days.lab_task: Script a developer's daily tasks with the Zowe CLI, set up a new developer in VS Code in under an hour and call a mainframe service through the API Mediation Layer.
days.deliverable: Scripts, onboarding guide and test results
checks: Data sets, jobs and outputs handled from the CLI
Call through the API Mediation Layer

days.topic: Understanding Legacy Code with Analysis Tools
days.lab_task: Analyse a 200-program application, produce call graphs and data flow for the billing calculation, find dead code and run an impact analysis for a field length change.
days.deliverable: Analysis reports, dead code list and impact analysis
checks: Programs and calls for billing shown
All programs and data sets affected listed

subtopics: Removing GO TO and dead code
days.lab_task: Write characterisation tests for a tangled program, refactor it in small steps by removing GO TO and extracting subprograms, and show tests pass and complexity drops.
days.deliverable: Tests, refactored code and complexity comparison
checks: Run characterisation tests after each step

days.topic: Moving Mainframe Workloads to Cloud Platforms
subtopics: Rehosting with emulation: Micro Focus and others
Data migration from VSAM and Db2
Batch and online on the target
days.lab_task: Rehost a small batch and CICS application on a cloud emulation platform, convert one program to Java with an automated tool, compare outputs and estimate running costs.
days.deliverable: Rehosted application, converted program, equivalence results and cost estimate
checks: Run the batch on the target

days.topic: Replicating Mainframe Data to Cloud and Analytics
subtopics: Change data capture from Db2 and VSAM
IBM Data Replication and Precisely Connect
days.lab_task: Replicate Db2 account changes to Kafka with change data capture, convert formats, load them into a cloud warehouse and measure latency from commit to warehouse.
days.deliverable: Replication configuration, Kafka topics and latency report

days.lab_task: Analyse response times for the top transactions, make a program threadsafe, fix a contention problem and show improved response time under load.
days.deliverable: Analysis, changes and before and after times

days.topic: Db2 for z/OS Tuning for Applications
subtopics: Access path stability with plan management
days.lab_task: Diagnose a batch job causing lock escalation and timeouts for online users, change the commit strategy and access paths and show the impact on both workloads.
days.deliverable: Trace analysis, changes and results
checks: Previous access path kept as a fallback

subtopics: CICS and MQ in a sysplex
days.lab_task: Design an application change so it works across two LPARs with Db2 data sharing, test a rolling restart of one LPAR and explain the design rules that keep work moving.
days.deliverable: Design notes, test results and design rules
checks: No transaction affinity to one region

subtopics: Capacity measured in MSUs and MIPS
days.lab_task: Read WLM service class performance for online and batch, find a batch job driving the four-hour peak and propose changes that lower the peak.
days.deliverable: Performance analysis and peak reduction proposal
checks: Goals met or missed per class
Job and its MSU use identified

days.topic: Mainframe Software Cost and MIPS Reduction
days.lab_task: Find the top ten CPU consumers, estimate savings from tuning, zIIP offload and rescheduling, implement two changes and report measured savings.
days.deliverable: Consumer list, savings plan and results
checks: Savings estimated under the pricing model

subtopics: Encrypting Db2 and coupling facility data
days.lab_task: Encrypt a sensitive data set, protect API traffic with AT-TLS, review RACF access to production data for excessive permissions and write audit findings.
days.deliverable: Encryption setup, TLS configuration and audit findings
checks: Read the encrypted data set without key access

days.topic: AI Code Assistants for COBOL: watsonx Code Assistant for Z
subtopics: What AI assistants do for mainframe teams
tools: IBM watsonx Code Assistant for Z
days.lab_task: Use an AI assistant to explain a complex program, transform one service to Java, generate tests and check every output against the original behaviour.
days.deliverable: Explanations, Java code, tests and review notes
checks: Same results as COBOL for all test cases
Time compared with doing it by hand

days.lab_task: Map the critical path of a nightly batch that overruns, parallelise independent streams, remove two redundant steps and show the new end time.
days.deliverable: Critical path, changes and new timings

days.topic: Analysing SMF Records and System Data
subtopics: Analysing SMF with Python or Splunk
tools: Splunk or IBM Z Operational Log and Data Analytics
days.lab_task: Extract a week of SMF job records, analyse them with Python for CPU, elapsed time and failures by application and build a dashboard used in a morning review.
days.deliverable: Extraction job, analysis notebook and dashboard
checks: Job records for the week loaded

days.lab_task: Build an automated integration suite with Galasa for the banking transactions, virtualise an external dependency, mask test data and run it in the pipeline.
days.deliverable: Test suite, virtual service and pipeline results
checks: Run the suite in the pipeline

days.topic: Knowledge Transfer and Mainframe Skills Planning
days.lab_task: Build a skills and knowledge matrix for a team of ten, identify the three biggest single points of knowledge, plan transfer for each and design a graduate training path.
days.deliverable: Skills matrix, transfer plans and training path
checks: Three critical areas named with owners
Path leads to independent work in six months

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Modernising a Core Banking Application
days.lab_task: For a case core banking system, assess and choose a modernisation path, expose key services as APIs, set up a DevOps pipeline with automated tests, replicate data to the cloud, cut CPU cost and present a funded roadmap to a leadership panel.
days.deliverable: Assessment, APIs, pipeline, replication, savings report and roadmap presentation
checks: Change built, tested and deployed automatically
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one programme
